name: Judas
bio: Judas, surnamed Barsabas, was a leading man among the Jerusalem brethren and a prophet, chosen along with Silas to carry the Jerusalem Council's letter to the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia, explaining that they need not be circumcised but should abstain from food offered to idols, blood, meat from strangled animals, and sexual immorality. He and Silas delivered the letter and encouraged the believers there before being sent back to Jerusalem in peace (Acts 15:22-33).
